Note: Edit and restart the game. Model is a folder under HCT15Content\assets\models (the body without wheels), or empty to keep the donor's own body - PaintLow/PaintHigh ("#RRGGBB", the vertex colour the game stores, which renders about twice as bright) then repaint its body colour in two tones meeting at PaintSplit (a fraction of the body height), and PaintRoof above 0 paints a glass roof above that fraction; glass, lights, grille and tyres keep theirs. Donor is a retail car (ItemId or Name), empty = the first suitable one - pick one shaped like the car you are building ('kombi' is the van, 'legend' a saloon), because the wheels, the shadow and the lights stay the donor's. Performance ~0.7..1.0 scales top speed and acceleration. Length, Width and Height each scale the body against the donor's own box, so Height 1 sits as low as every retail car and 1.5 is half again as tall; Lift raises it off the ground, Yaw turns the model (90 = a model whose nose is +X in the .obj). The speech bubble lifts itself over the body as the race camera sees it, so a big body cannot be drawn over its own insults; BubbleUp adds to that lift, BubbleClear also slides the bubble towards the camera, and -1 turns both off and leaves the bubble where the donor had it; BubbleEdge true hangs it at the roof edge nearest the camera instead (the micro). Cars\_donors.json and cars\_bubbles.json are written beside this file with the measurements the Car Editor reads. Sprite = a folder under cars\sprites: the body is then a camera-facing pixel sprite instead of a mesh, LeanStep degrees of heading per lean frame, LeanSign -1 if it leans the wrong way, SpriteScale 1 = the sprite as big as its 3-D car in the world (every car by the same law, by its distance), 1.5 = half again; Campaigns = the mod campaigns the car is selectable in and races as a rival (empty = everywhere).
